messages: Nina (Design): heads-up: I shrank the embeddings batch mock to test narrow widths and found three usability issues: 1) vector columns push actions off the right edge, 2) rerank score lacks context, 3) export modal wording is vague. want a quick sync on fixes. Alex (Eng): quick wins: collapse vector columns behind a single cell labelled `Vectors (dims)` that expands inline. keeps table narrow and reduces initial DOM nodes. Rae (A11y): expand control must use `aria-expanded` and keyboard shortcut `e` when a row is focused. also the collapsed content should move focus into the expanded region and be announced. Nina (Design): good call. visual: show `Vectors · 768 dims` then a chevron. when expanded show first 12 dims inline and a `View full` link. copy for `View full`: "Open full vector in side panel". Owen (PM): product ask: export modal should be explicit. change title to `Export Vectors (CSV)` and subtext: `Includes id, dims_count, rerank_score. Vector columns are optional and may be large.` we should surface estimated file size for full-rows exports. Pri (ML): estimated size is important. rough calc: CSV row with 768 dims (floats) ~ 6KB. multiply by rows to estimate. show a warning bar when estimated > 10MB with suggestion to sample or use compressed_base64. Alex (Eng): implementation note: if user requests full export > 50k rows, kick off a background job and email a link when ready. modal should say `Export queued - we'll email you when it's ready` and offer a cancel button. Rae (A11y): background jobs need announcements via polite live region: `aria-live="polite"`. but ensure we don't spam for small exports. focus should return to the export button when modal closes. Nina (Design): UX for sampling: dropdown with presets: `First N`, `Random N (default 1,000)`, `Stratified by rerank bucket`. include short helper text under each option. add `Save as preset` checkbox. Owen (PM): analytics: emit event with `export_method`, `sample_type`, `preset_saved` and `export_size_estimate`. useful for troubleshooting large exports. Pri (ML): for stratified sampling show a tiny preview counts table in the modal like `0.0-0.2: 120 rows, 0.2-0.4: 300 rows...` so users can tweak bucket sizes. show a sparkline alt text `Score distribution sparkline`. Rae (A11y): sparkline must have `role="img"` and `aria-label="Score distribution: low to high"`. don't rely on hover tooltips; duplicate text in sr-only description. Alex (Eng): performance: cap preview rendering to 150 rows by default and add a non-blocking banner: `Previewing 150 of 23,421 vectors. Export will include all rows unless sampled.` Banner should be dismissible and have `role="note"`. Nina (Design): banner copy tweak: "Previewing 150 of 23,421 vectors. Export will include all rows unless you choose a sample." add a small `Why?` link that opens a short explainer. Rae (A11y): ensure the `Why?` link is focusable and when activated moves focus into a dialog with `role="dialog"` and initial focus on the dialog heading. Owen (PM): copy for rerank score column: show numeric value plus a toggle `(raw | percentile)`. default `raw`. inline help: `Percentile shows relative rank among visible results.` include `aria-pressed` for the toggle. Pri (ML): percentile requires computing distribution client-side for visible rows; for large previews compute on sampled subset and annotate that it's approximate. add small `~` prefix for approximations. Alex (Eng): noted. can compute percentile on preview subset; for real export add exact percentiles server-side if requested. Nina (Design): microcopy for truncated dims: show `dims: 768` in row and `hover/focus` reveals `First 12 dims: [0.12, -0.03, ...]`. Rae: hover-only isn't accessible. Rae (A11y): yes. ensure the first12 snippet is exposed via `aria-describedby` and available on keyboard focus. avoid relying solely on mouse hover. staging-bot: preview deployed for branch `feature/embeddings-compact-export` at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/embeddings-compact-export Alex (Eng): can folks smoke test staging on Mac VoiceOver + NVDA on Windows? I'll paste a small aria example in the PR: ``` Vector dims: 768. Press E to expand row. ``` Nina (Design): thanks. I'll update the mock and add the export modal copy. Owen 1 any timeline constraints? Owen (PM): aim to behind-flag next Tuesday. blockers only if a11y patterns aren't implemented in PR. Rae (A11y): will block if aria-expanded/focus management or live-region announcements are missing. otherwise I'll sign off after QA. Nina (Design): great. I'll post final mocks and a short checklist in the PR. :rocket:
